about: House numbers and building names printed on the base plan of Suenn Ho's (何巽) route maps of 1991 (M+ CA17/2/1-3), read from the 1000 px online images. px: map pixels of copy CA17/2/3. plan: the same point in data/plan.json metres (tools/route_map_fit.py). readers: A and B are two readers of a tile, C is a later check of the street frontages. street: the street of the number where the map makes it clear and the model has no lane there (the south part of Lung Shing Road).
source: M+, Hong Kong. CA17/2/1-3, Suenn Ho, route maps, 20-21 Nov 1991. See primary-sources/mplus-suenn-ho-ca17/SOURCE.md.
